name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline, sit back, and plant both feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand palms forward, letting your arms hang vertically behind your torso.
Bend your elbows to curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders without swinging your upper arms forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms hang straight at your sides again.
tips: Keep your shoulders resting against the backrest throughout the curl.
Avoid letting your elbows drift forward as you lift or swinging the weights from the bottom.
